description: Ravi Kumar and Arun Raj were spotted near Gandhipuram bus stand intercepting a cash transit vehicle with weapons. Informant reported communication with Suresh.
Break-in reported at an electronics warehouse in RS Puram. Suspect Dinesh Karthik fled the scene on an unregistered motorcycle after disabling CCTV cameras.
Two-wheeler theft ring intercepted near Peelamedu railway crossing. Manoj Tiwari and Vijay Sethi detained while attempting to alter engine chassis numbers.
Local textile merchant reported coercive extortion demands and threats delivered via phone. Informant linked demands to Ravi Kumar and Suresh operating from Erode.
Luxury SUV stolen from hotel parking in Salem. Tracking signals showed vehicle moved towards Coimbatore border. Witnesses identified Arun Raj and Dinesh Karthik.
Fake land patta registration scam uncovered at registrar office. Amit Patel and Anand Verma implicated in forging revenue documents and accepting illicit cash payments.
Commercial gold ornaments stolen from jewelry workshop in Town Hall. CCTV captured Vijay Sethi providing surveillance while an accomplice breached back door.
Phishing infrastructure and unauthorized SIM-box routing detected operating out of commercial apartment. Ravi Kumar, Arun Raj, and Vikram Singh coordinated operations with Priya Sharma.
Protection money demand delivered to building contractor. Phone records indicate calls originating from RS Puram tower traced to Rajesh Nair and Suresh.
Online job recruitment racket collecting deposits via mule UPI accounts. Amit Patel, Anand Verma, and Vikram Singh linked to coordinating shell beneficiary accounts.
Interstate truck hijacking carrying copper wire spools on Avinashi Road bypass. Dinesh Karthik and Arun Raj intercepted during highway patrol check.
Cryptocurrency investment scheme fraud defrauding multiple investors of senior citizen savings. Syndicate managed by Vikram Singh, Ravi Kumar, and Priya Sharma.
Unauthorized OTP interception and bank account takeover. Technical forensics traced spoofed SMS gateway to Priya Sharma and Karthik Subbaraj.
Armed robbery at financial lending firm. Two masked men threatened cashier at gunpoint. Eyewitness vehicles tied to Suresh and Manoj Tiwari.
Synthetic contraband distribution intercepted near interstate checkpost. Consignment tied to Suresh, Rajesh Nair, and Meena Sundaram transporting packages.
Threatening letters and extortion calls made to industrialist. Caller ID spoofed to display government vigilance numbers. Traced to Karthik Subbaraj and Amit Patel.
Loan default scam using forged GST invoices and dummy company accounts. Coordinated by Vikram Singh and Deepa Loganathan.
Ransomware attack on municipal billing database demanding crypto payments. Decryption wallet and ransom chat linked to Vikram Singh, Priya Sharma, and Ravi Kumar.
